name: Elias Schwalme
title: Founder
conviction_themes: People coming out of big companies build for the wrong era — you must build for the current moment, not the one you left
Two years behind in tech is very hard to catch up on — speed and currency matter enormously
Open-source multimodal vector databases (e.g. LanceDB built on Arrow + Rust) are the right infrastructure direction
Terminal-first developer environments (Wezterm, tmux, neovim) are superior for serious ML/infra work
Enterprise sales is brutal — even a $2.3M deal pitch can be derailed unexpectedly
previous_experiences: Founded Lee-AI Inc., an AI chatbot avatar app (Lee), built and shipped to App Store
Founded and announced Scape after many months of work
Portfolio company (top 20 globally) at Antler, presented at Antler Elevate SF
Honored on the Midas Brink List
Previously interned at neuplan in Munich
Previous roles at Deloitte and BMW Group
bio_text: Elias Schwalme is a San Francisco-based founder and AI/ML builder who studied at the Technical University of Munich and has shipped consumer AI products including Lee-AI (an AI chatbot avatar app) and Scape. He is an Antler portfolio company (top 20 globally) alumnus with prior experience at Deloitte and BMW Group, and holds strong convictions about building for the current technological era rather than the one you came from.
